label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
To my neighbors at Larkspur Lofts,

My name is Jess Okafor, and I have lived in 5A for three years. Many of you have seen the note posted in the lobby about a drone being flown from the roof deck. That was me, and I would like to explain what happened.

I am a wedding photographer. On Saturday, October 31, at around 4 p.m., I took a new drone (a Halvard Mini 4) up to the roof deck to test it before a vineyard wedding in Dundee. It was in the air for about 11 minutes in total. The camera was pointed west, toward the river and the Fremont Bridge, for the entire flight. It was never pointed at anyone's windows, and I was not filming anyone in the building.

Even so, I understand why it was alarming. A buzzing object hovering over the courtyard is unsettling when you don't know who is flying it or why, and I should have let people know beforehand. One neighbor told me that children visiting her that day were frightened by it. I am sorry for that, and I am sorry to anyone else who was worried.

If you would like to see the footage, I am happy to show you the full, unedited clip. Please knock on 5A or email me at jess.okafor@mailbox.example.

Our HOA rules do not currently say anything about drones. I will ask the board to add the topic to the agenda for its meeting on November 19 at 7 p.m. in the community room, and I will not fly from the roof again until the board has decided on a rule. I hope anyone with an opinion will come.

I do also need to say something about the note itself. Being called a creep in the lobby, with my unit number attached, was hurtful. It made me feel singled out in my own home over something I would gladly have explained. I am not interested in who wrote it. I only ask that in the future, if something I do concerns you, you come and talk to me directly. I will listen.

Thank you for reading this.

Sincerely,
Jess Okafor
Unit 5A

I left Doreen's name and unit out, since she told you that privately and this goes to all 24 units.

reasons: The final sentence is a note about the task rather than part of the letter.
